dedupe_keys.name: georocket scalable data store for citygml and other geospatial files

description: GeoRocket is a high-performance data store for geospatial files such as CityGML 3D city models, GML and GeoJSON: any stored file can be restored completely, several files (for example a city model and a terrain model) can be merged into one scene on retrieval, and spatial and attribute queries return only the matching features merged into a valid file. It uses Elasticsearch for search and Vert.x for a reactive design meant to handle large files and many parallel requests on one machine or in the cloud. Development is led by the Spatial Information Management competence centre of Fraunhofer IGD in Darmstadt. Coverage: generic. Access: free download and source on GitHub. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: the latest release listed on the website is 1.3.0 from September 2018, so the project appears dormant. Simulation uses: serving large CityGML building models to urban simulation and digital twin workflows with spatial subsetting. Related records: 3DCityDB and the OGC CityGML standard.
